items.title: Actual numerical phase: synchronous increment in the source metric

source.anchor: Lemma4.8, (4.16), HTML621-628; actual Lemma4.6 numerical expansion
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; actual synchronous increment at exposed normalized-curvature interface, explicit universal constants, not full paper.

items.statement: For the actual full exact-gradient two-refresh two-Picard Phi, the synchronous increment difference obeys sqrt Q_kappa((Phi_z-Phi_zprime)-(z-zprime)) <=12 h sqrt Q_kappa(z-zprime), under the explicit normalized C2 curvature interface and actual h Lambda<=1/(65536 kappa). This is the source difference of increments because vector subtraction is additive. The source universal C is explicitly elaborated as12, with the same c1/65536 as the actual contraction. All compared states and common noise values are included.
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. f:E->R is globally C2, kappa>=1, and its genuine nested second derivative satisfies (2kappa)^-1||v||^2<=D2f(z)[v,v]<=||v||^2 for every z,v. This is the explicit normalized smoothed-potential interface; the actual f=V_eta producer remains independently open.

J>=2,h>0. Actual Chebyshev-Lobatto nodes t_j=h/2(1-cos(j*pi/(J-1))), cardinal polynomials ell_j and ordinary Lebesgue integral weights omega_ij=integral_0^t_i(t_i-s)ell_j(s)ds, b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s)ds,c_j=integral_0^h(h-s)ell_j(s)ds. Lambda=sup_[0,h] sum_j|ell_j| and h Lambda<=1/(65536 kappa). No supplied convenient weights, Hessian, phase or remainder certificate.

a=exp(-h/2),sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)); P0=a p+sigma zeta0; Y0_j=x+t_j P0; Y1_i=Y0_i-sum_j omega_ij gradient f(Y0_j); Phi=(x+hP0-sum_j c_j gradient f(Y1_j),a(P0-sum_j b_j gradient f(Y1_j))+sigma zeta1). The same two noise vectors are shared by the two inputs. The inequality is for every z,zprime,zeta, not only almost surely.

Q_kappa(x,p)=((2kappa)^-1+1/2)||x||^2+inner(x,p)+||p||^2. The source M_kappa norm is sqrt Q. Intermediate Euclidean phase norms are the true WithLp2 product; the ordinary product max norm is not substituted.

obligations.label: Actual numerical synchronous increment at exposed normalized curvature
Stochastic errors/history/cost and both full main/composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Actual Lemma4.8 normalized-curvature numerical interface only. The actual f=V_eta smoothing/C2/curvature producer is a separate prerequisite before claiming the fully instantiated source lemma. No measure-level contraction, Khat/Kbar bias/variance, local discretization, invariance, history/expected query cost, Wp/proxy-warmness/initialization, PBPS or either full main/composition result is proved here. TV closeness cannot transfer unbounded expected cost.
